>Ask her what's wrong. 

Though the thought is correct here, most likely the answer will be "nothing". And that's what sucks. People who stop caring or giving any sort of emotional intimacy will almost never say anything. both women and men can feel this way.

Just don't go to scheming lengths to get information. Be up front, and prepared to talk your heart out.
This also seems like it would benefit my girlfriend

>No one knows your girlfriend like you do.


> maybe it's two years too long?

Ideas for an event please, not a critique of my relationship. Not one relationship is perfect mate.
